style.backgroundSystem: paper-cut storybook diorama backdrops: flat sky-blue #6C9BC2, dusty pink #C98B96 or mauve #A67BA0 walls with layered mint-green #A9D8C4 paper hills, white paper clouds and tree/mushroom cutouts; flat light-grey #F2F0F1 panels for info screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single stroke weight, deep plum #3D2645, minimal complexity
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-top key, soft contact shadow, cheerful even tone, no harsh shadows
style.lockText: {style_lock} consistent playful premium mother-and-baby ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sky-blue #6C9BC2, mint-green #A9D8C4 and dusty pink #C98B96 bases with magenta-purple #B23A9B product accent and deep plum #3D2645 text; warm tone; paper-cut storybook diorama backgrounds with white paper clouds, layered paper hills and tree or mushroom cutouts alternating with flat light-grey #F2F0F1 info panels; bright soft studio lighting with front-top key and soft contact shadows, no harsh light; rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only; thin-line circular outline icons in deep plum; rounded rectangular label bars and dashed rounded callout boxes; stable centered product presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero family angle for variant panels; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no realistic photo backgrounds breaking the paper-cut system
style.presentationRules: single stable centered hero object; consistent slight 3/4 hero family angle across variant panels; product clearly the subject; at most one small toy prop; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte paper-craft backdrop with layered paper ground in the same hue family as the wall
style.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only, deep plum #3D2645 on light panels and #FFFFFF on colored panels; no mixed fonts
